summary: The note is a clipped page from the Copernicus Climate Data Store (CDS) titled 'reanalysis era5 complete tab overview'. Apart from the page title, it contains only website navigation, a notice that a new CDS will soon launch with possible disruptions, and footer links such as About C3S, Contact us, Cookies and Disclaimer/Privacy. It contains no substantive information about the ERA5 reanalysis dataset itself.
one_line: Clipped Copernicus Climate Data Store page titled 'reanalysis era5 complete tab overview', containing only site navigation and a launch notice.
key_facts: The page is titled 'reanalysis era5 complete tab overview' and is from the Copernicus Climate Data Store.
The page notes that a new CDS will soon be launched and that some disruptions should be expected.
The site navigation menu lists Home, Search, Datasets, Applications, Toolbox, Support, Live and Climate Atlas.
The footer menu links to About C3S, Contact us, Cookies and Disclaimer / Privacy.
The note contains no substantive description of the ERA5 reanalysis dataset beyond its title.
